table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	PatientCode = P.PatientCode,
	PatientRegNo=P.Regno,
	PatientName= LTRIM(RTRIM(P.Name)) + ' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.PatientCode))) + ')',
	Phone = P.Phone,
	Address = LTRIM(RTRIM(P.Address1)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(P.Address2)),
	FatherHusband = P.FName,
	Prefession = P.Profession,
	Gender = P.Gender,
	CustCode = P.CustCode,
	Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=P.CustCode),
	NIC = P.NationalIDCard,
	MobileNo1 = P.MobileNo1,
	MobileNo2 = P.MobileNo2,
	MobileNo3 = P.MobileNo3,
	LastVisit = (SELECT MAX(V.VisitCode) FROM Visit V WHERE V.PatientCode=P.PatientCode),
	LastAdmission = (SELECT MAX(PA.AdmissionCode) FROM PatientAdmission PA WHERE PA.PatientCode=P.PatientCode)
FROM
	Patient P
WHERE
	(
		P.RegNo LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_regno='' OR :as_regno IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_regno END) OR
		P.Name LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_name='' OR :as_name IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_name END) OR 
		P.FName LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_fhname='' OR :as_fhname IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_fhname END) OR 
		P.Profession LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_profession='' OR :as_profession IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_profession END) OR
		P.NationalIDCard LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_nic='' OR :as_nic IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_nic END) OR
		P.Phone LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_phone='' OR :as_phone IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_phone END) OR
		P.MobileNo1 LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_mobileno1='' OR :as_mobileno1 IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_mobileno1 END) OR
		P.MobileNo2 LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_mobileno2='' OR :as_mobileno2 IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_mobileno2 END) OR
		P.MobileNo3 LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_mobileno3='' OR :as_mobileno3 IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_mobileno3 END))
ORDER BY
	PatientName,
	PatientRegNo
